title: LetsDate
tagline: A Decentralized Dating App for community works on native DATE Token
description: In this world of decentralization, are you still looking for your significant other? LetsDate is the place for you! Join us now to meet single men and women across the world. It is a Decentralized Dating App for community works on native DATE Token . We are going to launch token soon for this platform.
how_its_made: It is made using  Lens Protocol for Nft based authentication, Sanity.io as API Management, Moralis for Authentication, Alchemy for Polygon node server management, IPFS for nft storage. Using lens protocol it is quite easy to manage nft based profiles and logic of minting nft on successful match.
